description: Part single, part two storey rear/side extension involving demolition of existing garage/storage extension.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing Block Plan, dated 16.07.2026Proposed Block Plan, dated 16.07.2026Location Plan, ref: 5026Existing and Proposed Ground Floor Plans, ref: YJ/PP-100, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed First Floor Plans, ref: YJ/PP-101, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed Roof Plans, ref: YJ/PP-102, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed Rear Elevations, ref: YJ/PP-103, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed Front Elevations, ref: YJ/PP-104, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed Side Elevations, ref: YJ/PP-105, dated 16.07.2026Existing and Proposed Sections A-A, ref: YJ/PP-106, dated 16.07.2026Flood risk assessment, dated 17.08.2026Flood Level, Surface Water Mitigation & SuDS Plan, dated 17.08.2026SuDS Design and Maintenance Note, dated 17.08.2026SuDS ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.  Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no windows, doors, or other openings shall be inserted into the external elevations of the development hereby approved other than those expressly shown on the approved plans, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy, outlook and residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policy DMD 8 and DMD 37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Prior to the commencement of above-ground works, the mitigation measures set out in the Flood Risk Assessment dated 17 August 2026 shall be implemented in full. The development shall thereafter be carried out and maintained in accordance with those measures for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk and the discharge of surface water outside the curtilage of the site, and ensure that the drainage system remains functional throughout the lifetime of the development, in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy and Policies DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Development Management Document.
